title: Describe the clip/b-roll you need to Gemini or Claude, have it generate a video…
content: Describe the clip/b-roll you need to Gemini or Claude, have it generate a video prompt, then paste that prompt into Seedance to create the footage.
tips: Describe the clip/b-roll you need to Gemini or Claude, have it generate a video prompt, then paste that prompt into Seedance to create the footage.

es.content: Describe el clip/b-roll que necesitas a Gemini o Claude, haz que genere un video prompt, luego pega ese prompt en Seedance para crear el metraje.

fr.content: Décrivez le clip/b-roll dont vous avez besoin à Gemini ou Claude, faites-le générer un prompt vidéo, puis collez ce prompt dans Seedance pour créer les séquences.

ja.content: クリップやBロールの説明をGeminiやClaudeに伝え、ビデオプロンプトを生成させ、そのプロンプトをSeedanceに貼り付けて映像を作成します。

ko.content: Gemini나 Claude에게 필요한 클립/비롤을 설명하고, 비디오 프롬프트를 생성하도록 한 다음, 그 프롬프트를 Seedance에 붙여 넣어 영상을 만드세요.

pt.content: Descreva o clipe/b-roll que você precisa para o Gemini ou Claude, peça para gerar um video prompt, e então cole esse prompt no Seedance para criar a filmagem.

zh.content: 描述您需要的剪辑/B-roll给Gemini或Claude，让它生成一个视频prompt，然后将该prompt粘贴到Seedance中以创建素材。
